db.clean_start: WhatsMine starts fresh in this version. Your old chats and key were removed, so add your contacts again.
db.recovered: Your message database was damaged and has been reset. The damaged copy was kept next to it.
db.volatile: Messages can't be saved on this device right now. They will be lost when you close the app.
net.offline: No connection. Messages will be sent when you're back online.
chats.title: Chats
chats.empty_subtitle: Tap the button below and share your key, or paste someone else's.
chat.pending_note: Waiting for {name} to accept your request. You can already write; your messages are delivered once they accept.
chat.empty: Say hi! Messages go straight to their device, encrypted.
add.title: Add someone
add.your_key_hint: Show this code or send your link. Whoever opens it can ask to chat; you choose whether to accept.
add.request_hint: They'll see a request and choose whether to accept.
add.err.invalid_key: That doesn't look like a WhatsMine key. Check it and try again.
requests.title: Requests
requests.empty_subtitle: When someone adds you with your key, you decide here whether to accept.
requests.outgoing_hint: They see your request the next time you're both online.
contact.key_hint: To be sure this is really them, compare this key with the one on their phone, in person.
contact.block_message: They can't reach you anymore and won't be told. You can unblock them under Contacts.
contact.delete_message: {name} is removed from your contacts and the chat is deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.read_receipts_hint: If you turn this off, you won't see other people's read receipts either.
settings.last_seen_hint: If you turn this off, you won't see other people's last seen either.
settings.typing_hint: Let contacts see when you're typing, and see when they are.
settings.about_text: No servers, no accounts, no phone numbers. Your messages are stored only on your devices.
settings.about_limits: Messages go directly. When someone is away, yours keeps trying and tells you plainly how it goes.
settings.wipe: Delete my identity and all chats
settings.wipe_hint: There's no backup anywhere. Once deleted, it's gone for good.
settings.wipe_message: Your key, contacts and all messages are erased from this device. People will no longer be able to reach you on your old key. The app will close.
attach.unavailable: Can't open the file picker here.
voice.no_permission: Allow the microphone to record voice messages, then try again.
voice.failed: Couldn't start recording. Is a microphone connected?
camera.error: Can't use the camera. Check that no other app is using it and that it's allowed.
file.open_failed: No app found to open this file.
file.declined: Not accepted: it's larger than their limit.
file.over_limit: Larger than your limit. Raise it in Settings and ask them to send it again.
settings.max_file_hint: Bigger files are declined automatically and the sender is told.
call.unavailable: You can only call contacts who are online.
call.err.mic: Can't use the microphone. Allow it and try again.
call.err.cam: Can't use the camera. Allow it and try again.
call.err.media: Something went wrong with the call audio or video.
group.name: Group name
group.no_contacts: Add a contact first: groups are made of your contacts.
group.inactive_short: You are no longer in this group
group.inactive: You're no longer in this group. You can read the history, but not write.
group.remove_message: They will no longer get this group's messages.
group.leave_message: You will keep the history but get no new messages.
group.leave_admin_message: The group goes on without you: someone else becomes its owner.
group.delete_message: This removes the group and its messages from this device.
group.err.too_many: A group can have at most 16 members.
group.err.not_a_contact: Only your contacts can be added.
group.err.already_member: They are already in the group.
group.err.not_admin: Only the admin can do this.
settings.notifications_hint: Tell me about new messages, requests and calls when the app is not in front.
settings.previews_hint: Off: notifications only say that something came in.
settings.background_hint_android: A quiet service keeps your connection open, so messages and calls arrive at once even when the app is closed. It has a small notification you can hide.
settings.background_hint_desktop: Closing the window keeps WhatsMine running in the tray, so messages and calls arrive at once.
settings.autostart_hint: Starts hidden in the tray when you sign in.
contacts.empty_subtitle: People you add show up here, even after you delete their chat.
contacts.blocked_hint: Blocked people can't reach you. Unblock them to chat again.
chats.delete_message: The messages are deleted from this device. {name} stays in your contacts, and a new message from them opens the chat again.
forward.title: Forward to…
invite.blocked: You blocked {name}. Unblock them first to add them again.
invite.title: Add {name}?
invite.body: They get a request and choose whether to accept. Check that this is the right person.
contact.mute_hint: Messages still arrive, you just aren't notified.
contact.delete_chat_message: The messages are deleted from this device. {name} stays in your contacts, and a new message from them opens the chat again.
add.scan_hint: Hold the code inside the frame
add.link_copied: Link copied. Send it to someone; opening it adds you.
add.clipboard: There's an invitation on your clipboard.
add.greeting: Say who you are, if you like
add.read_out: Get a code to read out
add.read_out_note: Read this out. It works once, for 10 minutes.
add.read_out_text: A short code they can type in. It works once, for 10 minutes.
add.their_code: Their link, name code, or the code they read out
add.err.code_not_found: Nobody found with this code. Check it, or ask them to open WhatsMine for a moment.
address.bothered_text: Reset your address. All links stop working. Your contacts stay and notice nothing.
address.intro: Strangers can only leave a request here. They can't reach your phone or see where you are.
address.reset_1: All your links and your name code stop working
address.reset_3: Your contacts keep talking to you and don't have to do anything
address.reset_4: You get a new link straight away
address.reset_done: Your address is new. The old links no longer work.
address.reset_name: Also change my name and photo
address.row_note: Your links, and reset if bothered
address.title: Your public address
calls.empty_subtitle: Calls you make and get show up here.
calls.title: Calls
chat.err.no_message: That message is no longer here.
chat.err.not_yours: Only whoever wrote it can do that.
chat.send_later_note: It goes by itself at this moment. If your device is off, it goes when it is back on.
chat.update_to_see: Update WhatsMine to see all of this
chats.new: Start a chat or add someone
connection.hard_note: Your network blocks direct connections and no relay is available. Messages wait until one side changes network.
connection.offline_note: Messages wait here and go as soon as there is a network.
connection.reachable_note: Contacts can connect to you directly
connection.relayed: You are reachable through a relay
connection.relayed_note: A relay introduces you. It carries sealed traffic and cannot read it.
connection.resting_note: Nothing is held open now. New messages are looked for every few minutes.
connection.title: Connection
contact.disappear_note: New messages in this chat disappear on both sides after this long.
contact.labels_note: Words of your own. Folders can go by them. Nobody else sees them.
contact.notes_hint: Only for you. Birthdays, how you met.
contact.words_text: Compare these with {name}, on a call or face to face. If they are the same, nobody stands between you.
delivery.knocked: A note was left for them
delivery.knocked_note: Sealed, for when their phone next looks
delivery.legend_failed: Stopped trying. You can try again
delivery.legend_two: On their device. Blue means read
delivery.on_its_way: On its way over a connection
delivery.stopped_note: Stopped after the time you set. Try again or delete it.
delivery.title: Where is this message
devices.title: Your devices and backup
devices.words_text: Write these down and keep them safe. Whoever has them can be you, so never send them to anyone.
folders.intro: Folders appear as chips above your chats.
folders.labels: It has one of these labels
folders.name: Name
folders.title: Folders
health.battery_note: Your phone can stop WhatsMine to save battery, and messages come late.
health.notifications_note: So you see messages and calls.
health.restricted_note: Someone turned this off for WhatsMine. Messages only come while it is open.
health.revoke_note: After months without opening it, your phone would take these away.
help.title: Help and about
lock.title: WhatsMine is locked
look.title: Chat look
people.title: People
privacy.app_lock_note: Fingerprint, face or screen lock when the app opens. The app also stays out of screenshots and recent apps
privacy.relays_note: For when a direct connection is impossible. They carry sealed traffic and see IP addresses.
privacy.request_filter_note: Requests with one of these words go straight away.
requests.limits: Requests only show a name and a short greeting. No photos, and links don't open.
requests.quiet_note: No alerts for requests, they wait here
rich.place_failed: Your location could not be found.
rich.place_live: Live. Opens in your maps app
rich.place_private: It goes to this chat only. Nothing else hears of it until someone taps it.
rich.poll_many: You can pick more than one
saved.empty_text: Hold a message and save it, or ask to be reminded.
saved.title: Your list
speed.auto_text: Instant on Wi-Fi and while you use the app. On mobile data with the screen off, messages arrive within a few minutes. Small battery use.
speed.instant_text: Messages and calls come in right away, also on mobile data. Uses more battery.
speed.saver_text: Checks now and then, so messages can take longer. Least battery use.
speed.title: Speed and battery
start.allow_note: Camera and microphone are only asked for the first time you use them.
start.allow_text: With no company in between, your device has to stay ready by itself. Allow these so messages and calls reach you.
start.name_note: People you add see this name and photo. You can use anything you like.
start.nothing_to_allow: Nothing to allow on this device
start.text: No phone number and no account. Your messages live on your devices and go straight to theirs.
start.title: Talk to people. Nobody in between.
storage.on_mobile: Download by itself on mobile data
storage.title: Storage
devices.auto_backup_note: Every week, encrypted, to your downloads
devices.backup_note: A backup holds your chats, contacts and keys, not your files. Only your 12 words open it.
folders.quick_replies_note: One per line. They show above the empty message field.
folders.reactions_note: The ones offered first, with a space between them.
restore.done_text: Close the app and open it again to finish.
restore.err.wrong_backup: That file does not open with these words.
restore.err.wrong_words: Those are not the right 12 words. Check each one.
restore.pick: Pick a backup file, if you have one
restore.replaces: This replaces what is on this device now.
restore.text: Your 12 words bring back who you are. A backup also brings back your chats and contacts. Without one, add people again and they will recognise you.
saved.notes_note: A chat with only you in it
chat.err.slow_mode: Slow mode is on here. Wait a moment before your next message.
group.approve_note: Someone with the link waits for an admin
group.end_message: Nobody can send anything here any more. Everyone keeps what was said.
group.err.not_owner: Only the owner can do that.
group.link_note: Anyone with this link can ask to join. A new link makes the old one stop working.
join.asked: Asked. You're in as soon as they let you in.
join.body: Who runs the group gets your name and decides. You get to see the members.
join.title: Join {name}?
add.err.link_failed: Could not get everything over. Keep both devices open and try again.
devices.join_placeholder: The code from your other device
devices.join_text: On your other device: Settings, Your devices, Link a device. Scan or paste its code here.
devices.link_files: Your chats and contacts go along. Files stay here until someone asks for them.
devices.link_note: Your phone and PC, one you: messages show up on both, also when the other is off.
devices.link_step_1: Open WhatsMine on the other device and choose: I used WhatsMine before.
devices.link_step_2: Choose Link to my other device, and scan this code.
devices.other_note: Linked. Messages show up on both
devices.remove_text: It deletes everything of yours as soon as it is online. If you lost it, also reset your address, and keep in mind whoever has it holds your key until then.
devices.removing: Being removed as soon as it is online
chat.once_coming: A photo that can be seen once is on its way
chat.once_open: Photo, can be seen once. Tap to open
privacy.lock_after: Ask again when you come back
privacy.no_lock: This device has no fingerprint, face or screen lock set up, so there is no app lock, and hidden chats and your 12 words open without asking.
health.key_exposed_note: This device would not hold it, so whoever copies the app folder can read your chats. It tries again at each start.
look.err_font: That file is no font this app can use
look.delete_text: Chats with this look go back to the default.
look.name: Name
look.readable_note: Text colours adjust by themselves, so everything stays readable.
look.used_note: Changing this changes it in the {n} chats that use it.
look.font_file_note: Stays on this device. Whoever gets a copy of this look sees the system font.
look.photo_note: Your photo stays sealed on your devices, and only goes along when you share this look.
look.make_from: Make a new look from this one
look.only_you: Only you see this. Someone else gets a copy only if you send it.
look.card_note: A look for your chats. Nothing changes until you choose.
soft.name: {tint} {family}
call.share_text: They see what is on your screen until you stop, also notifications. WhatsMine itself stays hidden, so your chats and your 12 words do not show. Next you choose what to show.
call.share_busy: {name} is showing their screen right now
call.err_screen: Your screen could not be shown
call.speaker: Speaker
control.cannot: That is not possible on the PC of {name}
control.asked_off: {name} asked to control this PC. That is turned off, so nothing happened.
control.asked_new: {name} asked to control this PC. They have been a contact for less than a week, so nothing happened.
control.asked_not_now: {name} asked to control this PC. That is not possible right now, so nothing happened.
control.warning: Never allow this for someone who says they are from a bank, a helpdesk or the police. They never need this.
control.scope_window: They can use only the window you are showing.
control.scope_screen: They can use everything on your screen, as if they sat here. To limit them to one window, say no and show only that window.
control.what_stays: WhatsMine and admin prompts stay out of reach. Move your mouse to pause them, press Esc to stop. It ends by itself after 15 minutes.
control.tick: I know this person and I asked them for help
control.ended_time: The 15 minutes are up. Control has stopped.
control.ended_silence: The connection went quiet. Control has stopped.
control.ended_sharing: Sharing stopped, and control with it.
control.ended_unsafe: The screen locked, a secure prompt came up or the window closed. Control has stopped.
control.ended_wrong: Something that did not fit came in. Control has stopped.
privacy.control_note: Off unless you turn it on. Even then you are asked every time, only in a call, only while you share, and only for someone who has been a contact for at least a week.
privacy.control_in_call: This cannot be turned on during a call
status.title: Status
status.limit: Statuses go sealed to the people you choose, and only reach them when both of you are around within the 24 hours.
status.who_all_note: Everyone in your contacts when you post. Who you add later does not get what you posted before.
